export_evidence: ImportKey India page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/excel-controlinkage-pvt-ltd) shows 5 export rows, all to Italy, e.g. exact line: "2022-10-01 | EXCEL CONTROLINKAGE PVT. LTD. | FLEXBALL ITALIANA S.R.L. | MECHANICAL CONTROL CABLES | Nhava Sheva, India | Genoa, Italy | 840023 | NAG30007H300". Other dated rows: 2022-09-27 (BOL NAG20007B200), 2021-02-25 (NAG200073200), 2020-02-27 (NAG300076600), 2019-10-24 (NAG900073900) — same buyer, same HS 840023, same Nhava Sheva→Genoa lane. Source counter: page advertises a large historical dataset ("back to 2008") but only 5 export rows were actually visible on the free view; 5 rows seen. Note: the HS code shown in the customs record is 840023 (mechanical control cables), NOT the declared 401693/401699/730441/731210 — declared HS does not match the actual shipment code.
domestic_evidence: Company website (https://www.excelcontrolinkage.com/) states: "Excel Controlinkage Pvt. Ltd., a Greaves Company, is a prominent player in motion control systems in the domestic and international markets. Established in 1994, Excel is a tier 1 supplier to leading OEMs" and "Excel is a leading motion control solutions partner to companies in sectors such as automobile, construction, marine, and agriculture, in 80+ countries worldwide." This is a self-declaration of domestic OEM supply (tier-1 to OEMs) with no named customer, contract, GST turnover figure or GeM/CPPP tender record visible. No GST turnover band, no tender/contract record and no annual-report split could be retrieved: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. GST turnover = null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (5 rows, 2019–2022, Nhava Sheva→Genoa, buyer Flexball Italiana S.R.L., BOL numbers quoted). Domestic supply is only declared on the company's own site (tier-1 OEM supplier claim) — no GST turnover, tender or contract record found, so domestic_status = declared_only. HS discrepancy: actual customs HS is 840023 (mechanical control cables), while declared HS 401693/401699/730441/731210 (rubber gaskets/seals, steel tubes, wire rope) does not match the shipped product; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base with HS corrected to the factual code 840023 and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Revenue/export volume figures: null (not public in free views). Industry claim 'oil & gas and chemicals' is not supported by any retrieved record — actual activity is motion control systems/control cables for automotive, construction, agriculture, marine, railways.
